name: Mofuku Rinkan Hitozuma Nikubenki ~Jutai~
original_name: 喪服輪姦人妻肉便器～受胎～
source:
A man appears at her husband's wake. She is forced to pay back the debt that her husband had left behind by having sex with the man, and others.

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE023407.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
丈夫的守灵仪式上，一名男子突然现身。嶋希美被迫以身体偿还亡夫遗下的债务，不仅要与此人发生关系，还得任由其他男人凌辱。

[引自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE023407.html]DLsite[/url]]
